# **Site Map for Mädchen Gebhard's Thesis: A subset of Shallow and Mesophotic coral reefs from the Territorial Coral Reef Monitoring Program**

##### Data is available from @hollander2025 and the Territorial Coral Reef Monitoring Program. 

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| out-width: "80%"
#| fig-cap: "Colored map of the U.S. Virgin Islands. Mesophotic points shown in purple and shallow points shown in green. Top panel shows St. Thomas and St. John. Bottom panel shows St. Croix with an excerpt map of the Caribbean Sea."

knitr::include_graphics(path.expand("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversityoftheVirginIslands/THESIS/coding_data/images/horizontal_map.png"))
```
